method.benchmark_compiler: Rust 1.92.0 / LLVM 21.1.3 for matched baseline, candidate and PGO benchmark binaries
method.interval: Source-game cluster percentile bootstrap; position-cluster sensitivity; omitted below two clusters
method.memory: Whole-process high-water RSS, including model and replayed corpus roots
method.nodes: Total visited nodes includes q nodes; q_nodes is a subset
method.primary_metric: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF): process user+system CPU milliseconds per search; wall time is a sensitivity
method.ratio: candidate/baseline geometric mean, equal measured-case weighting
method.scope: Fixed-depth equivalence; no strength or cold-start claim; incomplete prefixes excluded from pair totals
method.validation_tools: Final checks use CI-pinned Rust 1.97.0 and Ruff 0.16.8; separately recorded in tool provenance
